items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: Wallachs. Wallachs. Rudolph Wallachs. I set the cistern out and got it... I had never had my hand on a drum seat before... It started right out with the Wallachs drums.

ctx.x: Wallachs. Wallachs. Rudolph Wallachs. I set the cistern out and got it. Well, it's a realtor. It was. Yeah, and that drum was exactly six months getting here. See, that drum was six months getting... Yeah? Yeah. Well, getting to Mandeville. Wow. That's right. And I got that drum in there, but it got lost. Went all around, and I had to write back to em, you know, and they'd write back to me, and they'd trace it. And it'd take exactly six months for that drum to come. I had never had my hand on a drum seat before.…
You didn't have any hand on a drum seat before. Can you imagine?
